title: A photograph from behind the rope
goal: Explain an access rule, distinguish a seasonal observation from long-term change, and return to the hide.

memoryNodes.cue: What decision does Lin bring back?

situation: A rope kept visitors back from the reeds. The sign described breeding behaviour seen in spring. Lin could see two birds near a nest, but not whether their young would survive. Successful reproduction needed more evidence than one quiet afternoon. The ranger marked the visits as seasonal and asked for observations later in the year. A bird perched on the island marker. Behind it, a map traced a long migration route. One visitor wanted a closer photograph and suggested widening the boardwalk. Lin stayed behind the rope. A better view was not worth disturbing the nesting area. She followed the same boards back to the shell-shaped handle, carrying a photograph taken from a respectful distance.
zhSupport: 解释通行规则，区分季节观察与长期变化，再返回观鸟屋。

migration 在此指鸟类迁徙，不是人口移居。
表达位置，也可用于说明遵守访客边界。
perch 表示鸟停在某处；常接 on + 支撑物。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A visitor wants to move closer to the nest. Explain why the rope should be respected.
acceptableAnswers: We should stay behind the rope to avoid disturbing the breeding area.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Give a practical rule and its purpose.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Two birds are near a nest, but their young have not been observed. Explain what is still unknown.
acceptableAnswers: We have seen breeding behaviour, but we do not yet know whether the young will survive.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Separate observed behaviour from a later outcome.

retrievalPrompts.function: Explain the need for another visit
retrievalPrompts.cue: The only record comes from spring. Explain why another season should be observed.
acceptableAnswers: This is a seasonal observation, so we need visits at other times of the year.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: One season cannot describe the whole year.

transferPrompt.cue: A nature reserve wants more visitors without damaging a nesting area. Suggest one rule and acknowledge a cost.
acceptableAnswers: Visitors could use a marked path, even if it means taking photographs from farther away.
transferPrompt.feedback: Offer a workable rule and admit its effect on visitors.
